_note: Roadside events. Shipping this file replaces the game's roadside pool while Salt Bell is active. Every autoChoice is safe (no breakdown, delay, loss, battle or requirement).

legs.text: The crust breaks under the lead truck. Black brine wells up around the axles, and the salt sucks at the wheels like a mouth.

choices.text: Rig the winch to the next truck and walk it out slowly.
Floor it and hope the crust holds further on.
Dump water barrels until she floats free.

legs.text: A line of pilgrims in salt-white robes crosses your track, carrying a little shrine with a little bell. The last of them lifts an empty water skin toward you without a word.

choices.text: Fill their skins. All of them.
Ask them where they are walking to, and why.
Nod, and drive around them.

legs.text: A mirror flashes from a basalt ledge, then another further on. Someone is signalling your position ahead - and it is not the scouts of Basalt Watch.

choices.text: Turn and run them down before they gather.
Cut across the soft pans and lose them in the glare.
Ease off and let them lose interest.

legs.text: Two Saltmen buggies pace you at a distance for an hour. Then one of them raises a fist - not a threat, a salute - and they peel off into the white. Word of the Glare Cut travels.

choices.text: Return the salute.
Follow their tracks at a distance - they know the firm ground.

legs.text: A trader has set up under a tarp beside a beached fishing boat. On a pallet sits the boat's old engine, rebuilt and painted salt-blue. 'Runs on anything. Even hope,' he says.

choices.text: Trade 10 water for the engine.
Swap a tyre for a crate of spares.
No room. Drive on.

legs.text: A red flare climbs out of the pans a mile off the track and hangs there, dripping light. Distress, or bait.

choices.text: Send a Fighter on foot to look.
Lights off. Keep rolling.

legs.text: Green scrub in a hollow of the old shoreline - the only green for miles. Someone says there is water under it, if you dig.

choices.text: Make camp and dig.
Mark it on the map and move on.

legs.text: The old ferry lane runs straight across the pan where the road bends around it. The salt there is thin, and a truck lies half sunk in the middle of it.

choices.text: Take the ferry lane. Fast and flat.
Stay on the road.
